entry.title: Generativetober Day 16 - Gangly
entry.content:
Animation

This is the first post where I'm including an animated version of the sketch. I'm not sure if I'm going to continue doing this but after Bob and I talked yesterday we were curious if it was possible to include that in these posts. Here you go Bob!

Static

Code

const white = [255,255,255];
const cyan = [88, 255, 255];
const magenta = [255, 88, 255];
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

class Walker {
  constructor(x, y, c, g) {
    this.x = x;
    this.y = y;
    this.lastx = this.x;
    this.lasty = this.y;
    this.tx = random(0, 1000);
    this.ty = random(1000, 9999);
    this.color = c;
    this.lean = random(-1, 1);
    this.age = 0;
    this.lifespan = random(5, 23);
    this.alpha = random(127, 255);
    this.gangly = g;
  }

  update() {
    this.tx += random(0.05, 0.08);
    this.ty += random(0.01, 0.05);
    this.lastx = this.x;
    this.lasty = this.y;
    this.x += map(noise(this.tx), 0, 1, -3, 3) + this.lean;
    this.y += map(noise(this.ty), 0, 1, -2, -1); // tend up
    this.age += 0.1;
    if (this.gangly 
        && random() < 0.1 
        && this.age < this.lifespan/2 
        && this.age > this.lifespan/4) {
      this.gangly.sprout(this.x, this.y, this.color);
    }
  }

  show() {
    if (this.age < this.lifespan) {
      stroke(...this.color, this.alpha);
      strokeWeight(map(this.age, 0, this.lifespan, 5, 0));
      line(this.x, this.y, this.lastx, this.lasty);
    }
  }
}

class Gangly {
  constructor(x, y, nStrands) {
    this.x = x;
    this.y = y;
    this.nStrands = nStrands;
    this.strands = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < nStrands; i++) {
      this.strands.push(new Walker(x+random(-25,25), y, random(colors), this));
    }
  }

  sprout(x, y, c) {
    this.strands.push(new Walker(x, y, c));
  }

  update() {
    for (const strand of this.strands) {
      strand.update();
    }
  }

  show() {
    for (const strand of this.strands) {
      strand.show();
    }
  }
}

let g;

function setup() {
  createCanvas(640, 640);
  background(0);
  showTitle();
  g = new Gangly(width/2, height, random(5, 25));
}

function showTitle() {
  stroke(255);
  fill(255);
  strokeWeight(1);
  textSize(16);
  text("Gangly", 10, height-10);
}

function draw() {
  g.update();
  g.show();
}

function keyPressed() {
  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("gangly.png");
  }
}

Discussion

The word "gangly" means awkward skinny lanky limbs on a person. Tall and skinny. Sometimes it's used to describe the legs of animals I guess. It feels bouncy in my mouth when I say it out loud, the tongue hits the teeth a bit. Anyway... I suppose this is the first post where I am trying to describe my thinking (per Bob's suggestion). I think I limbs reminds me of tree branches or trunks. I suppose after thinking about tree limbs I remembered the walker and how I could use that to make something "bush-like". I created a walker and did something basic with a single limb and liked how it looked. We can use perlin noise to make the growth of the limb look natural and have some variation. I combined this with an age variable so I could reduce the strokeWeight as the limb grows and age it down to a sharp point at the top end. Modify the walker to always grow upward and give random limbs a "lean" to the left or right and you end up with something vaguely like a growing limb. Threw on some random colors and random alphas just to differentiate them a bit.

The last thing I did was to add sprouts. A sprout is a probabilistic split around lifespan/4-/2 and this new limb gets added to the whole starting from that x,y coordinate. It's a nice little graphic and grows up until the limbs age out.

I think for future variations on this I'd like to play with keeping the variation but making the segments straight lines so it looks like a growing crack or crystal. I also want to play with creating multiple of these gangly groupings and having them vary in other ways.

entry.title: Generativetober Day 15 - Hooray
entry.content:
const white = "#fff";
const cyan = "#55ffff";
const magenta = "#ff55ff";
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

// Mover from Nature of Code
class Mover {
  constructor(x, y, m) {
    this.mass = m;
    this.radius = m * 1;
    this.position = createVector(x, y);
    this.velocity = createVector(0, 0);
    this.acceleration = createVector(0, 0);
    this.heat = 100;
  }

  applyForce(force) {
    let f = p5.Vector.div(force, this.mass);
    this.acceleration.add(f);
  }

  update() {
    this.velocity.add(this.acceleration);
    this.position.add(this.velocity);
    this.acceleration.mult(0);
    this.heat -= 3;
  }

  show() {
    stroke(255, map(this.heat, 0, 100, 255, 88), 255, map(this.heat, 100, 0, 255, 80));
    strokeWeight(2);
    fill(127, 127);
    circle(this.position.x, this.position.y, this.radius * 2);
  }

  contactEdge() {
    return (this.position.y > height - this.radius - 1);
  }

  bounceEdges() {
    let bounce = -0.5;
    if (this.position.x > width - this.radius) {
      this.position.x = width - this.radius;
      this.velocity.x *= bounce;
    } else if (this.position.x < this.radius) {
      this.position.x = this.radius;
      this.velocity.x *= bounce;
    }
    if (this.position.y > height - this.radius) {
      this.position.y = height - this.radius;
      this.velocity.y *= bounce;
    }
  }

}

let particles = [];

function setup() {
  createCanvas(640,640);
  background(0);

  let x = random(width/5, width-width/5);
  let y = random(height/5, height/2);
  fill(magenta);
  stroke(magenta);
  circle(x, y, 5);
  
  for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
    particles.push(new Mover(x, y, 1));
  }
}

function showTitle() {
  // Title
  strokeWeight(1);
  stroke(0);
  fill(cyan);
  textSize(16);
  text("Hooray", 10, height-10);
}

let firstTime = true;

function draw() {
  for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
    let mover = particles[i];
    let gravity = createVector(0, 1);
    mover.applyForce(gravity);

    if (firstTime) {
      mover.applyForce(createVector(random(-20,20), random(-25,5)));
    }
  
    if (mover.contactEdge()) {
      let c = 0.1;
      let friction = mover.velocity.copy();
      friction.mult(-1);
      friction.setMag(c);
  
      mover.applyForce(friction);
    }
  
    mover.bounceEdges();
    mover.update();
    mover.show();
  }

  showTitle();
  firstTime=false;
}

function keyPressed() {
  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("hooray.png");
  }
}

entry.title: Generativetober Day 14 - Lady
entry.content:
const white = "#fff";
const cyan = "#55ffff";
const magenta = "#ff55ff";
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

class Walker {
  constructor() {
    this.tx = 0;
    this.ty = 10000;
    this.x = width/2;
    this.y = height-height/3;
    this.lastx = this.x;
    this.lasty = this.y;
  }

  step() {
    if (this.y >= height) {
      return;
    }
    
    this.tx += 0.02;
    this.ty += 0.01;
    this.lastx = this.x;
    this.lasty = this.y;
    
    let xnoise = map(noise(this.ty), 0, 1, -20, 20);
    let ynoise = map(noise(this.ty), 0, 1, 0, 1);
    
    if (this.x < width/2) {
      xnoise += dist(this.x, 0, width/2, 0) * 0.05;
    }
    if (this.x > width/2) {
      xnoise -= dist(this.x, 0, width/2, 0) * 0.05;
    }

    this.x += xnoise;
    this.y += ynoise;
  }

  show() {
    if (this.y >= height) {
      return;
    }
    stroke(color(88, 255, 255, map(this.y, height-height/3, height, 100, 255)));
    strokeWeight(map(this.y, height-height/3, height, 0, 10));
    line(this.x, this.y, this.lastx, this.lasty);
  }
}

let walker;

function setup() {
  createCanvas(640, 640);
  background(0);

  stroke(127);
  fill(127);
  textSize(16);
  text("Lady", 10, height-10);

  stroke(white);
  strokeWeight(0.1111);
  noFill();

  line(0, height-height/3, width, height-height/3);
  
  walker = new Walker();
}

function draw() {
  walker.step();
  walker.show();
}

function keyPressed() {
  if (key == "s") {
    saveCanvas("lady.png");
  }
}

const white = "#fff";
const cyan = "#55ffff";
const magenta = "#ff55ff";
const colors = [white, cyan, magenta];

function setup() {
  createCanvas(640, 640);
  background(0);
  stroke(255);

  for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
    let x = width/2 + random(-250,250);
    let y = height/2 + random(-100,100);

    stroke(random([127, 167, 207, 255]));
    
    line(
      width/2 + random(-10,10), 
      height, 
      x,
      y
    );

    let randomColor = random(colors);
    stroke(randomColor);
    fill(randomColor);

    triangle(
      x,
      y,
      x+random(-50,50),
      y+random(-25,25),
      x+random(-25,25),
      y+random(-25,25)
    )
  }

  stroke(127);
  fill(127);
  textSize(16);
  text("Flimsy", 10, height-10);
}

}

entry.title: Generativetober Day 12 - Toss
entry.content:
const white = "#fff";
const cyan = "#55ffff";
const magenta = "#ff55ff";

function setup() {
  createCanvas(640, 640);
  background(0);

  // 1. Create a tiny 2x2 grid for a checkerboard/dither pattern
  patternImg = createGraphics(2, 2);
  patternImg.noStroke();
  patternImg.background(250);          // Primary color
  patternImg.fill(40);                 // Secondary dither color
  patternImg.rect(0, 0, 1, 1);
  patternImg.rect(1, 1, 1, 1);

  // 2. Convert p5.Graphics to an HTML Canvas Pattern
  let ctx = drawingContext;
  let pattern = ctx.createPattern(patternImg.canvas, 'repeat');

  // 3. Apply pattern fill and draw standard p5 shapes
  ctx.fillStyle = pattern;
  stroke(127);
  strokeWeight(1);

  triangle(0, height, width/2, height/2, width, height);
  
  for(let i = 5; i < 25; i++) {
    fill(random([white,cyan,magenta]));
    circle(
      width/2 + random(-i*10, i*10),
      height/2+i*10,
      i
    );
  }
  
  stroke(200);
  fill(200);
  textSize(16);
  text("Toss", 10, height-50);
}

function draw() {
}

function keyPressed() {
  if (key == 's') {
    saveCanvas("toss.png");
  }
}
